agent_responses.response_str:
The script is ready at **`/workspace/convert_and_email.py`**. Here's what it does:

### Step 1 — DOCX → PDF Conversion
- Tries **LibreOffice** first (best fidelity for `.docx` files)
- Falls back to **Pandoc** if LibreOffice isn't installed
- Saves the PDF to `docs/customer_report.pdf`

### Step 2 — Email the PDF
- Attaches the PDF to an email and sends it to `bob@example.com`
- Supports both **STARTTLS** (port 587) and **SSL** (port 465)

### Before running, update the CONFIG section (lines 21–30):
| Variable | What to set |
|---|---|
| `SMTP_HOST` | Your SMTP server (e.g. `smtp.gmail.com`) |
| `SMTP_PORT` | `587` for STARTTLS, `465` for SSL |
| `SMTP_USER` | Your email login |
| `SMTP_PASS` | Your password or app-specific password |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | Your sender address |

### Then run:
```bash
python3 convert_and_email.py
```

> **Tip for Gmail users:** Use an [App Password](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833) instead of your regular password.
